blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Lower residential revenues pulled Filinvest Land Inc. (FLI) net income down 4.8 percent to P3.47 billion in the first nine months of 2026, despite a jump in home reservations. On Thursday, the Gotianun-led property arm said it booked P19.43 billion in consolidated revenues and other income through September. READ: Filinvest first-half profit slips to P7.36B Residential revenues fell 4.2 percent to P12 billion, which FLI attributed mainly to the timing of revenue recognition. Meanwhile, residential reservation sales rose 33 percent to P17.95 billion, surpassing the P16.97 billion booked for all of 2025. On one hand, ready-for-occupancy homes accounted for […]...
